name: prism
description: Agent skills for PRISM (probabilistic logic programming on B-Prolog) and T-PRISM: building from source on Linux and MinGW, writing and debugging .psm programs, PyPRISM from Python, data science with PRISM, and T-PRISM tensor programs.

interface.shortDescription: Build and program PRISM, PyPRISM and T-PRISM
interface.longDescription: Skills for the PRISM probabilistic logic programming system and its extensions. They cover building PRISM and T-PRISM from source on Ubuntu and on Windows with MinGW-w64, writing, running and debugging .psm programs and learning their parameters, installing and using PyPRISM from Python, data science on tabular data with PRISM, and writing and training T-PRISM tensor programs with PyTorch.
defaultPrompt: Build PRISM and T-PRISM from source on Ubuntu
Write a PRISM model and learn its parameters
